head: MS NOW's live feed comes to TV apps without cable
dek: Versant's MS NOW now streams its live 24/7 feed to its members on Roku, Apple TV, Samsung, Google TV and Amazon Fire TV, without a cable subscription for the first time. Membership costs 7.99 dollars a month or 79.99 dollars a year.
details: Members also get full episodes of MS NOW programs on demand in the TV apps. People with a participating TV provider can sign in with that instead. Member-only series and twice-daily live Q&As with its journalists are planned for early 2027.
where: US, on Roku, Apple TV, Samsung, Google TV and Fire TV
means: If you want MS NOW live on your TV without cable, the membership now covers the TV apps too.
todo: Install the MS NOW app on your TV device and sign up, or sign in with your TV provider.
